propositions: Installing rebar from source via local-path pipx fails reporting that pipx needs uv>=0.9.17 when host uv is older.
The failure is a host pipx/uv toolchain mismatch, not a rebar packaging defect.
The workaround is to run pipx install with --backend pip on the local path.
README.md's 'From source' section should document the observed uv>=0.9.17 error and the --backend pip workaround.
